name: Mixed Dermis Disorder

criteria.description: Histopathological evidence of dermal thickening with mixed inflammatory infiltrate
Presence of specific autoantibodies targeting dermal components
Characteristic clinical presentation of mixed dermal lesions including induration and erythema
Elevated inflammatory markers such as ESR or CRP
Exclusion of other known dermal disorders by clinical and laboratory evaluation

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: All three major criteria must be met for diagnosis
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires integration of clinical, histopathological, and serological data.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Diffuse dermal induration with mixed inflammatory infiltrate
searchTerms: indurated skin with mixed inflammatory cells

pathognomonic.symptomName: Erythematous plaque formation with dermal thickening

common.symptomName: Pruritic skin lesions with variable scaling

searchTerms: white blood cell infiltration in skin

common.symptomName: Mild joint stiffness associated with skin involvement
searchTerms: mild joint stiffness with skin rash
slight joint tightness and skin changes
joint stiffness linked to skin symptoms

occasional.symptomName: Mild alopecia localized to affected skin areas
searchTerms: patchy hair loss on skin lesions
localized hair loss in rash areas

occasional.symptomName: Low-grade fever during active disease phases
Muscle weakness proximal to affected dermal regions
searchTerms: weakness in muscles near skin rash
muscle weakness close to affected skin

rare.symptomName: Pulmonary fibrosis secondary to dermal inflammation
searchTerms: breathing problems due to lung fibrosis
pulmonary fibrosis related to skin disease
kidney problems with protein in urine
lack of tears and dry eyes

imaging: High-resolution CT scan for pulmonary fibrosis assessment
genetic: No specific genetic mutation identified; possible HLA associations under investigation
other: Histopathology revealing mixed inflammatory infiltrate with dermal fibrosis

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of sclerodactyly and specific autoantibodies (anti-Scl-70)
Characteristic heliotrope rash and Gottron papules

redFlags: Development of respiratory symptoms suggestive of pulmonary fibrosis
